title: Telecom core network
goal: Show redundant router and fibre paths within a core-network reliability path.

rubric.must: A left-to-right reliability path visibly represents telecom service success path.
The drawing visibly shows two router-and-fibre paths visibly arranged in parallel.
The drawing visibly shows access aggregation and peering edge as series blocks.
Every component block visibly displays its reliability value.
Input and output terminals visibly bracket the success path.
A computed system-reliability summary is visible on the drawing.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/rbd/ideal.svg (sha256 1f4f1225b103), source sha256 32e8c8e70102. Independent recursive series/parallel drawing with all source blocks, separate complete redundant paths, reliability totals and Birnbaum importance computed from the success expression. Red borders mark actual single points of failure; highest importance uses green (inner border when both roles apply). All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
